Namaskaar Dosto, aaj ke video mein maine aapke saath share ki hai TCL ki latest technology from IFA 2026, Berlin. Is video mein hum dekhenge TCL QD-Mini LED aur SQD-Mini LED TVs, X11L, AI-powered AC aur Washing Machine, RayNeo AR Glasses, NXTPAPER devices, AiMe Robot aur kaafi aur interesting future tech. Comment karke zarur batana aapko inmein se kaunsi technology sabse interesting lagi? Mujhe umeed hai ki aapko yeh video pasand aayegi.
